name: ANTHEMIS NOBILIS
gi_symptoms: Aching in region of liver; griping and chilliness inside of abdomen and into legs. Itching of anus, with white putty-like stools.
urinary_symptoms: Bladder feels distended. Pain along spermatic cord, which feels full, as if varicosed. Frequent urination.
skin_symptoms: Itching of the soles, as if from chilblains. Gooseflesh.

source.title: ANTHEMIS NOBILIS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
